standard_prerequisites.name: Universal injectivity of the completion map into the product, flatness of the cokernel of a universally injective map, and the Mittag-Leffler criterion for a pure submodule
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: More on Algebra, label more-algebra-lemma-ui-completion-direct-sum-into-product (proof line 2013); Algebra, labels algebra-lemma-ui-flat-domain and algebra-lemma-pure-submodule-ML (proof lines 2017-2018)
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that the completion is a pure submodule of the product of copies of the ring, so that flatness and the Mittag-Leffler property descend from the product.

standard_prerequisites.name: Coherence and flatness of a product of copies of a Noetherian ring, and its Mittag-Leffler property
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, labels algebra-proposition-characterize-coherent (proof line 2021), algebra-lemma-Noetherian-coherent (proof line 2023) and algebra-lemma-product-over-Noetherian-ring (proof line 2025)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives that the product of copies of a Noetherian ring is flat and Mittag-Leffler, which combined with the purity statement gives the conclusion.

core_obligations: Reduce to the product: the completion maps universally injectively into the product of copies of the ring, so by the flatness and Mittag-Leffler criteria for a pure submodule it suffices to prove the statement for that product (proof lines 2010-2019).
Show the product is flat: coherence of the product of copies of a Noetherian ring gives flatness (proof lines 2020-2024).
Conclude Mittag-Leffler by the corresponding property of products over a Noetherian ring (proof lines 2024-2026).
proof_roadmap: Purity reduction to the product (proof lines 2010-2019).
Flatness of the product via coherence (proof lines 2020-2024).
Mittag-Leffler property of the product (proof lines 2024-2026).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a complete Noetherian ring the completion of a direct sum of copies of the ring is flat and Mittag-Leffler (statement lines 2002-2008, tag 05DL-adjacent). The proof uses that the completion maps universally injectively into the product of copies of the ring, so that flatness and the Mittag-Leffler property descend from the product, and then obtains flatness of the product from coherence and its Mittag-Leffler property from the corresponding statement for products over a Noetherian ring. The purity reduction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
